title: Exact-functor data presenting a coherent etale comparison
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], let A_X be its category of abelian Zariski sheaves, S_X the constant integer sheaf, and T_X the constant integer sheaf on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. An exact comparison presentation is an additive exact functor P from A_X to large-coefficient etale abelian sheaves [def-weil-size-convention], a map b:T_X→P(S_X), and maps d_F:P(F_ab)→F_et for every quasi-coherent module F [pqf-def-coherent, def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Require coefficient naturality and the following section normalization: applying P to the Hom representative of a degree-zero class, composing with d_F and evaluating on the section represented by b gives the lifted tensor-pullback unit of that class. Define its degree-q map by x↦b·P(x)·d_F in Ext.

proof.text: Record the exact functor, integer map and natural coefficient maps with their degree-zero unit equation. Define the cohomology maps by Ext composition; distributivity makes them additive.

proof_origin.place: 03P2 comparison and its section unit; exact-functor Ext argument written by F3, using the established normalized-comparison construction
